scope: Selection and promotion statistic of the dope-kpi/v2 scoreboard (dope_kpi primary, compare, null). The publishable claim stays the unclipped dope-fidelity/v3 coverage shares. An empirical privacy result is never formal DP or HIPAA de-identification.

statistic.name: twin-referenced retention gap
statistic.retention: R_x = (L0 - L_x) / (L0 - L_A); rows carry r_s (synthetic S) and r_b (real twin B)
statistic.entry_value: clip(r_s, clip_low, clip_high) - r_b for a scored entry; failed_value for an entry that was not scored
statistic.aggregation: mean over sample seeds per (cell, auditor); minimum over the auditors per cell; mean of cells within a family; mean of families within a task; mean of the tasks present
statistic.informative: per (cell, auditor) from the real reference only
statistic.not_applicable: an informative entry with status unsupported from a control arm leaves the cell out for that arm; a comparison keeps the cells applicable to every arm it reads

bootstrap.kind: stratified family bootstrap: families resampled with replacement within each task, the same draws for both arms of a comparison
bootstrap.rank: sorted draws; lower bound at floor(lower_quantile * (draws - 1)), upper bound at ceil(upper_quantile * (draws - 1))

promotion.multiplicity: holm step-down across the comparisons of one receipt
promotion.coverage: per cell the share of informative statistic entries whose realism (privacy) gate passed, a failed entry counting as a miss; the paired delta aggregates like the statistic; a missing flag leaves the guard not evaluated
promotion.exact_copy: mean over the candidate's scored headline files on the common cells of max(0, rate(S in A) - rate(B in A)); a missing value leaves the guard not evaluated

bytes.guard: a headline file is produced when it was scored or carries a measured packet; the guard fails when a measured packet exceeds headline and is not evaluated when a produced file has no measured packet or nothing was produced

null.kind: family sign flip: every family's paired differences multiplied by one independent fair sign, the full decision rule applied to each replicate
